data.name: 99 Nights
data.detailed_description:
Survive 99 Nights in the Wilderness

Chop down trees, gather fuel & scrap, search abandoned structures, and build a base camp strong enough to withstand what comes after the sun sets. The wilderness grows more dangerous with every passing night, and something is always watching from beyond the firelight.

The Campfire

The heart of your survival. The fire creates a safe zone that keeps the Bonehorn monster away and protects you from the night. Feed it with wood, coal, and fuel to keep it alive. Upgrade it to expand the explorable area, cook food, and reveal more of the wilderness. If the fire dies, you are no longer safe.

Crafting and Camp Building

Gather wood, scrap, and resources to craft tools, weapons, and essential survival equipment. Build workstations, farms, storage, and defences to strengthen your camp and survive longer nights. 

The Monster

The wilderness’ relentless hunter. The fabled Bonehorn Beast appears every night, stalking anyone outside the camp fire’s protection, it grows more dangerous over time. Light is your only defence. Outrun it, or stay within the fire’s glow.

Day and Night Survival

Use daylight to gather resources, hunt, explore, and prepare your camp. When darkness falls, threats emerge and survival becomes the only goal. The cycle repeats, each night more dangerous than the last.

Build, Explore, Survive

Upgrade your camp, manage resources, defend against nightly dangers, and push deeper into the wilderness. Every night survived is progress.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows Vista SP1+ or higher
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590, AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
